notes: Everything is in rounds/results.py: record_result checks, for GET and under the round lock for POST, a non-Open round, a superseded build, the signed-in tester's result and, on POST, a submitted result; services.record_result only upserts by (tester, case, build). So M1 drops the view's tester filter and passes the found result's tester to the upsert, so another tester's result is shown and overwritten; M4 also builds the form with the saved values for a submitted result and lets tester_result.html show it with the true status. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation (no database constraint) and RoundTextField(max_length=2000) limits it; M5 raises only the field's max_length, so its fixed message is unchanged. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005 to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
